title: Resolve lore instructions agents vs bare lore init: the documented Claude default is not what init.ts does
description: Routed by opum-agent OPAG-421, ADR gap 2 (opum-doc main 7831fff, docs/adr/distribute-lore-and-quest-agent-skills-through-the-plugin-marketplace.md (Amendments 1-4)). src/core/instructions.ts:~366 says 'lore init with no bridge flag and no prior selection still bootstraps Claude by default'; src/commands/init.ts:~874 calls applyAgentsBridge only when parsed.agents is set, so a bare non-interactive lore init creates no Claude bridge. Which side changes is lore-cli's call per the ADR. Decide by what the wizard, ADR-0017 and the cli-surface docs promise, and by whether a default bridge write would conflict with the marketplace check (a bare init selects no target, so it would have no plugin check to run).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The documented and coded default for a bare lore init agree, with the choice and its reason recorded on this task
A test pins the agreed behaviour of a bare non-interactive lore init with respect to the Claude bridge, and the lore instructions agents text matches it

DECISION 2026-09-26: the DOCS change, the code stands. A bare non-interactive lore init creates no bridge. Reasons: (1) init.ts header states it ("the non-interactive default is UNCHANGED ... scaffold docs/.lore/ and nothing else") and the docker e2e harness plus pre-LORE-260 tests depend on it byte-for-byte; (2) ADR-0017 lists --agents among the opt-in flags; (3) the wizard bridge multiselect pre-checks nothing (LCLI-462), so no init path, interactive or not, defaults to Claude; (4) a default bridge write with no selected target would have no runtime for the LCLI-592 marketplace plugin check. The "bootstraps Claude by default" sentence in src/core/instructions.ts conflated init with the bare lore agents fresh-repo default, which is real and unchanged (src/commands/agents.ts:284). Fix: that sentence now says a bare lore init creates NO bridge and points the Claude default at lore agents only. Pinned by test/init.test.ts "a bare non-interactive init writes no Claude bridge, and lore instructions agents says so": result.agents/plugins undefined, no CLAUDE.md, no .claude/, and the agents topic carries the new sentence and not the old one. Mutation: reverting only instructions.ts turns that test red (8 of its expects pass, the guidance assertion fails). Gates on the branch: bun test 3641 pass/0 fail, bun run lore check 0 errors, lint + typecheck clean.
